description: Source code for SubgraphRewriter and SubgraphMatcher classes implementing graph pattern matching and rewriting in PyTorch's native runtime.

classes.name: SubgraphMatcher
classes.description: Class for matching subgraph patterns within a computational graph.

classes.name: SubgraphRewriter
classes.description: Class for registering and applying pattern-based graph rewrites.

methods.name: findRootNode
methods.description: Finds the root node of a pattern graph.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Attempts to match a pattern starting from a target node.

methods.name: matchAll
methods.description: Finds all matches of the pattern within a graph.

methods.name: tryMatchNode
methods.description: Recursively attempts to match a pattern node with a target node.

methods.name: tryMatchNodeInputs
methods.description: Checks if inputs and attributes of pattern and target nodes match.

methods.name: tryMatchValue
methods.description: Checks if pattern value matches target value.

methods.name: isOutputValue
methods.description: Checks if a value is an output of the pattern graph.

methods.name: compareConstants
methods.description: Compares two Constant objects for equality.

methods.name: findMatchingAttribute
methods.description: Finds an attribute in a node matching a given attribute.

methods.name: findInputByName
methods.description: Finds an input argument in a pattern node by name.

methods.name: registerRewritePattern
methods.description: Registers a pattern and its replacement graph for rewriting.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes all registered pattern rewrites on a graph.

methods.name: runForPattern
methods.description: Applies a specific pattern and replacement to a graph.

methods.name: overlapsWithUsedNodes
methods.description: Checks if a match overlaps with already used nodes.

methods.name: rewriteMatch
methods.description: Rewrites a matched subgraph with a replacement graph.

methods.name: getVmap
methods.description: Creates a mapping from pattern graph values to their names.
